scenarios.title: 1. Verify initial disabled state of repository and review buttons
scenarios.purpose: Ensure that without configuration, the repository context indexing and review action are disabled as expected.

scenarios.title: 2. Confirm presence of setup required pill and inline setup hint
scenarios.purpose: Validate UI elements indicating setup is required before reviews can run.

steps.selector: div.setup-inline span:has-text("Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.")

scenarios.title: 5. Verify 'Load example diff' button loads sample diff with expected content
scenarios.purpose: Ensure example diff loads and the textarea contains the indicative placeholder text from the sample.
